QUEZON CITY WELCOMES VINCE DIZON AS DPWH SECRETARY

The Quezon City Government expressed full support for the appointment of Secretary Vince Dizon as the new head of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in a statement on Sunday, August 31.

"The Quezon City Government warmly welcomes the appointment of Secretary Vince Dizon as the new head of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH)," the statement read. "Secretary Dizon has consistently demonstrated exceptional leadership and dedication in every national responsibility entrusted to him-whether as former President and CEO of the Bases Conversion and Development Authority, as our country's COVID-19 testing czar, or most recently as Secretary of Transportation. In each role, he has delivered transformative results that directly benefited our people and strengthened public trust in government institutions."

The city government expressed confidence that under Dizon's stewardship, the DPWH would enhance transparency, accountability, and efficiency in public infrastructure projects. It highlighted expectations for strategic, science-based, and community-driven solutions to flooding, including the adoption and scaling of Quezon City's Drainage Master Plan.

The statement also extended appreciation to outgoing Secretary Manuel Bonoan for his years of service and contributions to the department.

"The Quezon City Government conveys its full support and active cooperation with Secretary Dizon and the entire DPWH as we work together toward building safer, more inclusive, and future-ready infrastructure for all Filipinos," the statement added.
